key_insight: High-dimensional GAN training becomes analytically tractable when heterogeneous latent covariances are compressed into a single probability-weighted effective second moment that controls the dynamics.
engineering_relevance: This gives designers a principled way to tune generator covariance and learning rates to improve subspace recovery and stability in practical GAN training.
method: Linear generator with a multi-feature quadratic energy discriminator.
Extend solvable GAN dynamics to class-dependent, correlated, and non-zero-mean latent structure.
Derive high-dimensional deterministic ODEs from the stochastic microscopic training process.
evidence_signal: The paper validates the ODE limit, phase boundary, and signal-boosting mechanism with numerical simulations, and reports improved subspace alignment on MNIST, FashionMNIST, and CIFAR-10 using informed generator covariance.
watch_item: Overly strong latent correlations can destabilize recovery, so covariance shaping must stay within the mode-wise stability interval set by learning rates and noise.
paper_title: Effective Covariance Dynamics in Solvable High-Dimensional GANs
